languages.prompt: Programming languages required for the job

frameworks.prompt: Software frameworks required for the job

role.prompt: Classify the engineering role from its primary responsibilities, using the title as supporting evidence. frontend means client-side UI/web application work; backend means server-side services, APIs, data or systems work; full_stack requires material frontend and backend duties. Ignore generic company descriptions and other teams. Choose null if none applies or evidence is insufficient.

is_backend.prompt: Does this role have material backend/server-side development responsibilities? True for backend and full-stack duties, false for a clearly frontend-only role, null if unclear.

us_authorization.prompt: Does this position explicitly require U.S. citizenship or U.S. government security authorization? Return true when the posting requires U.S. citizenship, an active security clearance, or eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. Return false when the posting explicitly says neither is required or states that general U.S. work authorization is sufficient. Export-control or U.S.-person language alone does not qualify when non-citizens can satisfy it without government security authorization. Return null when neither requirement is stated or the requirement is unclear.
